propositions: Extract build_model_settings() and build_usage_limits() from run() in runner.py into the existing themed leaf module structured_run.py using explicit parameters rather than a frozen carrier object.
build_usage_limits must return the tuple (usage_limits, req_limit, eff_max_iter) because eff_max_iter is not recoverable from the stored max(8, eff_max_iter) tool_calls_limit.
cache_settings must be passed in as a parameter, not recomputed, to preserve the self._model_override guard that keeps cache settings None on the offline TestModel path.
build_model_settings must be pure with no side effect: the _TEMPERATURE_WITHDRAWN_LOGGED dedup mutation stays inline in run() so structured_run.py never runtime-imports runner and stays a leaf.
Temperature must be withdrawn when caps.supports_temperature is False and retained when True, and per-request output/step caps may only raise the configured floor, never lower it.
runner.py must end under 700 LOC and structured_run.py under 500 LOC, without stripping travelling temperature/precedence comments to meet the size guard.
